findings.title: --fast (and --focus) behavior unspecified for architecture mode
findings.recommendation: The ADDED `Architecture mode runs six passes` requirement disposes of `--parallel` explicitly (accepted, no-op, noted like other wrong-mode flags), and `--mark`/`--skip-verify` are self-limiting via their mode-only baseline requirements — but `--fast` and `--focus` have per-mode subsets/scenarios defined only for proposal and system modes, leaving `/orbit:review --as architecture --fast` (or `--focus <lens>`) for the implementer to invent. Add one sentence alongside the `--parallel` disposition, e.g. `--fast` and `--focus` are likewise accepted but no-ops in architecture mode (all six passes run; the docs are small), noted in the report.

findings.title: Named/crystallized-explore creation descriptions elsewhere don't mention the new minimal .openspec.yaml
findings.recommendation: The delta already rewrites the `orbit/explore/<name>/ staging directory` requirement but leaves its `Created by explore in named/crystallized modes` scenario saying the directory is created "with an `explore.md` file" — while the orbit-explore-modifications delta now also creates the minimal `.openspec.yaml`. Same pattern in the un-delta'd `orbit-run-summary-emit` baseline (`Bare-mode explore non-emission and crystallization warning`, consequence 1 at orbit/specs/orbit-run-summary-emit/spec.md:155 and the `Confirmed crystallization writes first emit` scenario at :170). None of these are exclusive claims, so nothing contradicts — but since the conventions block is already MODIFIED in this change, extending that scenario's THEN to mention the metadata file is zero-cost; the run-summary-emit occurrences can be left (accurate, merely non-exhaustive) or picked up at a later touch.

recommendation_options.label: A
recommendation_options.body: Extend only the already-MODIFIED orbit-conventions scenario (add "and the minimal .openspec.yaml per orbit-explore-modifications"); leave the run-summary-emit baseline untouched as non-contradictory.

recommendation_options.label: B
recommendation_options.body: Also add a 19th MODIFIED block for orbit-run-summary-emit's crystallization-warning requirement so consequence 1 and the confirmed-crystallization scenario name the metadata file.
